strings.verse.settings.title: Settings
strings.verse.stage.help: Third person: WASD or the arrow keys walk the commander, Shift hurries, E works the station within reach. 1, 2 and 3 pick the bird's-eye view, third or first person; V cycles them. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom. Click the deck to walk there, click a crew member for their record. Hold F to unleash Arc Storm, lightning from both hands. B folds out the hoverboard, which glides across the deck much faster.
strings.verse.stage.help_duel: The duel arena is in the Reactor Shaft on deck 3 (Reactor Engineering): press E at a console on the reactor ring, or use Duel on the tool rail from any deck.
strings.verse.stage.help_eye: Third and first person play like a shooter: a click on the view takes the mouse, moving it turns the camera, Esc gives it back. WASD walks relative to the view, Shift hurries; the left button or E works what the crosshair is on (a crew member, a station), else E works the station within reach. Scroll to move the camera in or out: all the way in is first person, scrolling out of it comes back. 1, 2 and 3 pick the bird's-eye view, third or first person; V cycles them. The settings button on the tool rail sets mouse sensitivity, inverted look, field of view and quality. Hold F to unleash Arc Storm, lightning from both hands. B folds out the hoverboard, which glides across the deck much faster.
strings.verse.tier.adaptive.desc: Starts at hard and moves towards an even fight as the set goes on.

strings.verse.tier.normal.desc: A steady opponent who leaves you room to learn the hall.
